templates.name: home
templates.description: Nile Air home page. Layout styled after Qatar Airways homepage. Sections: hero carousel (promo slides), quick-links row, 'Why choose Nile Air?' feature grid, 'Our Promotions' fare-card carousel, 'News Room' cards, mobile app download CTA, FAQ accordion, newsletter signup. Includes a hardcoded booking widget content block near the top.

templates.name: baggage-allowance
templates.description: Nile Air baggage allowance page. Layout styled after Qatar Airways baggage/allowance. Sections: breadcrumbs + page title, cover image with intro text, baggage allowance table (striped, by route), revision note, transport of local liquid products policy list, and Baggage Allowance FAQ accordion.

templates.name: travelling-pets
templates.description: Nile Air travelling with pets page. Layout styled after Qatar Airways baggage/animals. Sections: breadcrumbs + page title, cover image with intro text, Service Pets copy, Pets accordion (containers/food), contact form, and Travelling With Pets FAQ accordion.
